$comment: The self-study hub's list: courses, their profile (STANDARD.md section 2), their modules and their self-study lessons. A lesson with a path is opened from its own folder; nothing is copied. cover = the course's first-screen photo, from its first built lesson. status: planned (grey) | ongoing (orange) | done (green) | example (built as a sample, not in the mapping, not counted). profile: what = one line, how = how it is made. Lessons come from the self-study mappings: Self- Study/EAI/EAI_self_study_mapping_M1-M7.xlsx (Delivery mode = Self-study) and Self- Study/Digital Marketing/_Self-Study Mapping.xlsx (My choice = Self-study).
